scope: Fixed graph-guided physical path after v1 produced no supported endpoints for the difficult parent. Same original target; no learned controller.
guide_units: eV/A^2 spring constants; bonded rest distances equal the covalent-radius sum. Only existing single-bond condition0 graphs qualified.
guide_pairing: Before the map, guide with the initial graph. After the map, guide with its deterministic terminal-edge exchange. Require the final perceived graph to equal the latter, so the reverse uses the exact paired graphs in reverse order.
target_correction: Guided endpoint log ratio adds (guide_energy_final-guide_energy_initial)/kT, restoring the original physical target ratio. Every reverse Gaussian uses its actual guided force. No guide term is added to the stationary target.
per_cycle: Supported multiscale MALA, one symmetric guided exchange path, supported multiscale MALA.
intermediate_support: No hard chemical support requirement at intermediate vertices; both physical inversion orientations evaluated everywhere.
v1_outcomes_used_to_design_v2: v1 accepted4/64 paths per replica and had16/16 unsupported difficult-parent endpoints. Its negative results remain preserved.
stop_rule: Finish both bounded replicas, check paired guide graph reversal, guide force derivatives, endpoint correction, complete raw-query/RNG replay and cost. No new AI or general NCMC novelty claim.
